v1.0 — Internal Reference

01

The Brand Logo

Official Logo

The full lockup is the default logo. Use the navy-on-white version on light backgrounds, and the reversed white version on navy or dark photography.

Other

The rocket mark works alone as a favicon, app icon, or watermark once the full lockup has already appeared nearby. Never stretch or recolor the boosters — the tan stays tan.

Min. clear space = height of rocket nose
